ai_emerging_top10.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
ai_emerging_top10.about: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
ai_emerging_top10.readme_highlight: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It routes requests across providers, translates between OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, records operational metrics, and provides typed, composable routing algorithms.
